units.title: Polar surface measure
units.classification: Shared sphere-calculus support interface; definitions are not theorem credit
units.statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. Write \(\tau_n=\operatorname{vol}_{E_n}.\mathrm{toSphere}\), \(\sigma_n=\tau_n(S_n)^{-1}\tau_n\), and \(\mu_{n,N}=\bigotimes_i\sigma_n\); measure scaling uses the extended nonnegative-real inverse. Apply Mathlib’s polar-measure construction to Euclidean Lebesgue volume. This is a measure on the sphere subtype, not the ambient measure restricted to a sphere.
assumptions: Use the indicated canonical real Euclidean, unit-sphere and finite-product carriers; no positive-dimension restriction is imposed.
This is a definition or abbreviation. It imposes no unstated regularity, tangency, integrability or probability hypothesis.
